{{Top|leg}}
'''Maldovean Burtalle''' was a bottled [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage that [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Luewet Wuul]] stocked in his bar. It was from the [[Maldovea system/Legends|Maldovea system]], and [[Moagwood]] aging casks were essential in making a potent Maldovean Burtalle.<ref name="Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>

Wuul gifted a bottle of burtalle to Senator [[Ivaar Workan|Kameron Suldar]] after multiple arguments. Suldar considered the burtalle an apology gift and drank it in celebration, resulting in a slight [[Hangover/Legends|hangover]] when he received a [[Viewscreen/Legends|vidcall]] very early in the [[Local day/Legends|morning]] from Senator [[Abeloth|Rokari Kem]]&mdash;secretly the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] entity Abeloth.<ref name="Ascension">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref>
